title: Choose the visual world
question: New hand, few deep colours as you asked. The roll assigned Kinesio Strip. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Kinesio Strip
options.lineage: Kinesiology tape as physios apply it: woven deep-red strips with rounded ends
options.thesis: The page is held together the way a physio supports a joint: a few deliberate strips of deep red tape on clean white.
materials: woven tape with rounded cut ends
options.viewport: White page, logo top-left; two deep-red strips cross on one shallow diagonal behind a white booking card taped to the page with the nearest branch, open-now line and next slots as tape-cut chips; picking a slot lays a red strip across it; glass dock below.
options.risk: Tape tips into a sports-brand or craft-collage look if used beyond a few structural strips; deep red must keep clear of the navy-and-cyan logo.

raised.raise: Deep red is rationed to one meaning, act now (Book, your chosen slot, open now); nothing decorative is red.
Selecting a branch or slot pulls it into focus while everything else drops back to quiet grey.
Booking steps stack: finished steps collapse ghosted above, the current one arrives bright with an arrow to where it goes.
Delight hides one level deeper: tapping a degree chip (MPT, COMT, MIAP) explains it in plain words.
Every strip runs on one committed angle, so the page has a single direction of travel.

options.label: Prescription Pad
options.lineage: the Indian clinic letterhead and Rx pad printed in maroon ink
options.thesis: The site written on the clinic's own letterhead: credentials under the name, timings in the box, your slot prescribed below.
options.viewport: A letterhead band with the logo and Dr. P. Senthil's degree string in maroon; a ruled Rx area lists the nearest branch and next slots; a round BOOKED stamp lands on confirm.
options.risk: Can feel old-fashioned and paper-heavy, and prescription imagery suggests medicine rather than therapy.

options.label: Glazed Partition
options.lineage: steel-framed glass partition with a few coloured panes
options.thesis: A clear glass wall in thin black bars where one oxblood pane lights for what matters now.
options.viewport: A black-barred glass grid; the largest pane holds the booking card and the slot you pick floods oxblood; smaller panes hold rating, founder and branches.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and fits the few-deep-colours steer; loses on audience identification, since a glass wall is not part of a patient's physio world.
options.risk: Can feel architectural and austere; black bars may read heavy on small phones.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.thesis: Branch availability as a row of needles leaning toward the red.
options.viewport: A row of three meters, one per branch, needles showing how full each is today.
options.case: Fuses poorly: audio gear means nothing to patients, and ivory faces drift to the cream default.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Slots as a strobing barcode field.
options.viewport: A wall of hairline bars with slot times packed in monospace.
options.case: Fuses poorly: strobing black-and-white data is cold and stressful for people in pain.
options.kept: Selection pulls focus; the field drops back.

options.label: Brick Build Steps
options.thesis: Booking as numbered build steps with wordless arrows.
options.viewport: Big step numbers with the next booking piece dropping into place.
options.case: Fuses poorly: toy colours break the few-deep-colours steer and feel childish for a clinic.
options.kept: Done steps ghost; the current step arrives bright.

options.label: Pixel Metropolis
options.thesis: South Bangalore as a zoomable pixel city with three clinics.
options.viewport: An isometric pixel map with the three branches as buildings.
options.case: Fuses poorly: full-saturation RGB is the opposite of few deep colours.

options.label: Pulp Rocket Plate
options.thesis: Recovery as a rocket on a diagonal flight path.
options.viewport: A diagonal flight path carrying the booking steps.
options.case: Fuses poorly: retro pulp undercuts medical trust and yellows toward cream.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean clinic website in white and one deep red, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Photo hero with a headline and a Book button, service cards below, reviews carousel.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other clinic by design.
